verdict.rationale: Limitless is a consumer wearable and lifelog memory product: a pendant that records audio, with search, chats and a data API. Operator-facing per-run metrics such as success, duration and token or dollar cost belong to agent and workflow execution platforms, so this axis is a category error for this product type. The developer API does return chats, including scheduled-prompt chats with tool calls (limitless-docs-10, limitless-docs-12), but nothing in the evidence shows any run-metrics capability that would make the axis apply.
